project_info.theme: Galaxy Buds4 Pro color lineup poster
project_info.color_palette: White, black, pink gold, warm off-white, soft gray shadows

main_subject.detail: Clean color-option poster presenting three Galaxy Buds4 Pro variants with open charging cases and floating earbuds above, labeled White, Black, and Pink Gold with a samsung.com-only note.
main_subject.style: Photorealistic minimal product lineup render, airy premium ecommerce visual

composition_elements.text: Refined colors to match with your tunes / Galaxy Buds4 Pro / White / Black / Pink Gold / *samsung.com only
items: Top Left: Large centered headline 'Refined colors to match with your tunes'.
Top Right: Smaller centered subtitle 'Galaxy Buds4 Pro'.
Bottom Left: White Buds4 Pro case with matching floating earbuds and label 'White'.
Bottom Right: Pink Gold variant with floating earbuds, label 'Pink Gold', and blue note '*samsung.com only'.
Center/Background: Black Buds4 Pro variant centered between the white and pink gold versions on a clean warm-white background.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Smooth premium shadows, crisp product edges, calm showroom clarity

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for Galaxy Buds4 Pro color lineup poster. Centerpiece is a three-column arrangement of Galaxy Buds4 Pro charging cases with matching earbuds floating above them in White, Black, and Pink Gold finishes. Background is a clean warm-white ecommerce field. Surrounding elements: exact headline 'Refined colors to match with your tunes', subtitle 'Galaxy Buds4 Pro', labels 'White', 'Black', and 'Pink Gold', plus the note '*samsung.com only' under the pink-gold variant. Technical style: photorealistic product render, soft studio lighting, crisp edges and smooth premium shadows, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped

assets.name: Galaxy Buds4 Pro three-color lineup
assets.usage: Match exact case transparency, earbud positions, and finish colors.

assets.name: color-lineup labels and samsung.com note
assets.usage: Preserve the centered hierarchy and label placement beneath each product group.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Use refs for all three case/earbud colorways. The poster depends on symmetry and spacing, so keep the three-column layout exact.
